triples.tail_surface: Disassemble the Allen screws (2815) and remove the bearing cover (2115)
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 拆卸内六角螺钉并移除轴承盖
triples.evidence_text: 3 Disassemble the Allen screws (2815) and remove the bearing cover (2115).

triples.tail_surface: Use a proper puller to remove the bearings from the pump shaft
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 使用专用拉拔器从泵轴上拆卸轴承
triples.evidence_text: 6 Use a proper puller to remove the bearings from the pump shaft.

triples.tail_surface: Mount the preheated bearing (2250) carefully on the pump shaft at impeller side
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 将预热后的轴承(2250)小心安装到泵轴叶轮侧
triples.evidence_text:
3 Mount the preheated bearing (2250) carefully on the pump shaft at impeller side, with
                         the largest part of the inner ring facing the outer circlip and push it firmly against the
                         outer circlip. Let the bearing cool down!

triples.tail_surface: Mount the preheated bearing (2260) carefully on the pump shaft (2200) at drive side
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 将预热后的轴承(2260)小心安装到泵轴驱动侧
triples.evidence_text:
4 Mount the preheated bearing (2260) carefully on the pump shaft (2200) at drive side
                         and push it firmly against the outer circlip. Let the bearing cool down!

triples.tail_surface: apply a small amount of grease at both sides of the angular contact bearing (2250)
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在角接触轴承(2250)两侧涂抹少量润滑脂
triples.evidence_text:
5 Pull the rubber closure ring gently aside and apply a small amount of grease at both
                         sides of the angular contact bearing (2250). Push the closure ring back in its correct
                         position.

triples.tail_surface: Mount the lip seal (2180) at impeller side
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在叶轮侧安装唇形密封(2180)
triples.evidence_text: 13 Mount the lip seal (2180) at impeller side.
